2. Style & Aesthetic Guidelines
Medium & Art Technique
Style: Traditional medical/scientific hand-drawn illustration.
Linework: Crisp, fine-point black ink outlines with clean, consistent line weights.
Shading: Soft colored pencil and graphite shading, featuring delicate cross-hatching to define depth and contour.
Color Palette: Warm, muted pencil tones (natural skin/tissue hues, subtle accent colors like red/blue/grey where present in the original).
Paper Texture: Smooth, clean off-white or neutral paper grain without age stains or background noise.
3. Quality & Resolution Enhancements
Clarity: Enhance all fuzzy, pixelated, or compressed lines to sharp, high-definition details.
Fidelity: Retain 100% of the original drawing's structure, layout, dashed lines, arrows, and technical markings.
Cleanliness: Remove faint watermarks, digital noise, compression artifacts, and background shadows.
4. Layout, Borders & Margins
Border Removal: Completely strip away all outer black rectangular frames, dark edge lines, and vignetting.
Background: Extend the canvas background into a solid, seamless, uniform pure white (#FFFFFF).
Margins & Padding: Add a small, clean white margin around all four sides of the illustration so the subject breathes comfortably without touching the edges.
